title: The shared registry had no lock, six writers shared one temp filename, and a corrupt parse rebuilt it empty
symptom: Concurrent Job-T/Job-D writes could interleave into invalid JSON, which _load_registry's bare except then replaced with defaults over the 50 MB file; the merge separately flushed a hours-old snapshot, erasing everything harvested during the merge.
root_cause: Whole-file read-modify-write with no advisory lock, a fixed .tmp name, and an except that treated corruption as absence.
correction_made: registry_lock.registry_lock()/update_registry() with fcntl.flock; unique mkstemp temps for all six writers; corrupt files backed up and the error raised; the merge grafts only its own keys instead of flushing its snapshot.
